messages:
ash: Quick micro-thread  final SEO tasks for launch funnel: landing + 3 posts + webinar page. Need concise KW intent picks, tiny JSON-LD per page, anchor-text matrix, and rapid redirect rollback plan.
kim: I'll run intent labels. Plan: 1 branded + 1 commercial + 1 long-tail per asset. Will drop CSV link.
noah: Ill craft minimal JSON-LD: Event for webinar, Article for posts, BreadcrumbList for series, Organization on landing. Keep payloads <800 bytes.
tara: Internal links: hero->signup (primary), bench-post->landing demo CTA, cross-link posts, webinar->resources anchors. Make anchor text keyword-rich but natural.
seo-bot: Reminder: capture baseline clicks/sessions 7 days prior; tag with launch_id=LR-2025. Track median + p95 latency in benchmark narrative.
ash: Redirects: use 301 for permanent moves, 302 for experiments. Always deploy to staging first and run smoke with curl -I -L. Example Nginx rules:
rewrite ^/old-launch/?$ /launch/redwood-inference permanent;
location = /launch/variant { return 302 /launch/redwood-inference; }
kim: Action items: kim  KW CSV + intent labels by EOD; noah  JSON-LD snippets + breadcrumb template by Tue; tara  anchor map + CTA copy variants by Wed AM; ash  add redirect map to PR and coordinate staging smoke tests. Keep replies tiny for audit. :rocket:
